terms.comment: Someone who lives in a place; in law and in Cicero also a resident foreigner, as against a cīvis. The plural is the people of a place, “the locals”.
The person living in a house (a tenant), and then in a country.

phrases.latin: ventus — Volturnum regiōnis incolae vocant — adversus Rōmānīs coortus
phrases.english: a wind, which the people of the region call the Volturnus, rose against the Romans

phrases.latin: cum bonā pāce incolentium ea loca
phrases.english: with the goodwill of the people living there
